title: Chucklin's FNaF Pack
description: This mod is no longer being maintained please go download the newer version on my profile
body:
Fazbear Catalog - Coming Soon
"A complete remake of Chucklin's FNaF Pack with new and returning blocks remade"

This mod is now a archive for this old workspace of the mod!

Old description below

-Over 100+ blocks including a ton of walls, floors, and more!
-Lots of decor from tables, chairs, skytubes, and more!
-Lots of doors for whatever build you may need!

(also please don't port this to bedrock.)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

also thank all of you for getting this mod around 10000+ downloads!
